criterion_text: Real isolated Agent/Server CLI starts (foreground/background), malformed config, early validation failure and readiness failure produce retrievable sanitized diagnostics or explicit unavailable-path errors; normal runtime file/stdout logging and readiness/exit ownership remain intact, stderr flood cannot deadlock startup, Ctrl-C of logs does not terminate daemon. Runtime Case covers actual child processes and temp roots.

verifiers.summary: Real exact-SHA CLI processes proved retrievable sanitized startup diagnostics (config/validate/readiness/unavailable), intact runtime logging and ownership, bounded flood-safe readiness and reader-only Ctrl-C for `logs -f`.
